checks: Integer Fourier columns plus exp(-2*kappa*sin((theta-center)/2)^2) equal the prospective scalar equation; signed readout and intercept preserve wrap consistency.
Softplus concentrates positively without imposing an undeclared floor. Explicit concentration-underflow failure preserves the partial state.
Raw feature scales and all eleven feature/fitted-parameter counts agree with the protocol; the unrestricted line comparator includes theta/pi.
Frozen solve_readout uses centered Gram + n*lambda*I and reconstructs an unpenalized intercept, matching .5*MSE + .5*lambda*||weight||^2.

Joint Adam and VP initialize with the same exact ridge readout. Joint never refits after initialization. VP differentiates through the positive ridge solve and refreshes stored readouts for complete checkpoints.

Fitting clock starts before model construction/transfers/ridge setup. Checkpoint elapsed time follows validation scalars, CPU state clones and CUDA synchronization. Late checkpoints remain stored but are ineligible.
Checkpoint choice minimizes noisy validation MSE with earliest-tie selection. Clean grid arrays are accessed only after checkpoint selections are fixed.
Numerical failures and interruptions retain complete prior checkpoints and partial model state; earlier eligible states cannot convert a failed fit status into success.

Reviewed tests cover independent augmented least squares, VP finite differences/envelope gradients, float32/float64 shapes and finite gradients, boundary wrap, snapshot independence, controlled late timestamps, failure injection and CPU/CUDA parity.
